epic.title: WPP at Scale
epic.overview: Take the operational learnings from the first WPP pilot market and build them into the platform so the remaining WPP markets are easier to run than the first, with each feature designed to serve more than just WPP where possible.

milestones.title: M1 — Core Operational Efficiency
milestones.overview: The foundational bulk-management and monitoring tools research leads need to run large WPP projects day to day: survey compatibility, bulk survey actions, external panels, targeting bucket filtering, automated field reporting and WPP dashboard.

milestones.title: M2 — Expansion & Follow-On Builds
milestones.overview: Real-Time Survey Translation and Quota Management Between Cells require further conversation before build. Externalise Hardcoded Script Values is ready to build but was grouped here to keep M1 focused.

milestones.title: M3 — WPP API Platform
milestones.overview: Stand up fieldwork-api — a new, separately hosted serverless API (AWS Lambda/TypeScript, own repo) that (a) provides the data layer for the WPP Dashboard (F1.6) and (b) takes ownership of everything currently served by src/routes/wpp in dashboard-api (/wpp, /wpp/exports, /wppMonitoring), restructured for the ~470-cell multi-market scale of 2026-W1.

milestones.title: M4- WPP Dashboard
milestones.overview: Provide WPP with a dashboard showing how markets are progressing — a single up-to-date view of market progress without manual reporting. The dashboard is a static web app reading the hourly per-market MetricsSnapshot JSON from S3 (produced by M3 / F3.3); it does not read the database directly and has no backend of its own.

features.title: F1.1 — Excel Template & Survey Compatibility
features.overview: Validate the survey template against the demographic questions in the questions Excel before survey creation, to ensure the survey structure will be compatible with downstream coding and data delivery processes. Only demographic questions are validated at this stage, since other questions and options may be populated after creation (e.g., assigned to users later). This prevents launching surveys with mismatched demographic questions, options, or response values that could lead to incorrect data processing later.
features.rationale: Product signed this off as Done; two subtasks shipped to master and the other three are JIRA-Done without a PR confirming they reached master.

features.title: F2.3 — Quota Management Between Cells
features.overview: When a respondent hits quota fill, an API call checks remaining open surveys/cells within the same project and routes the respondent to the most suitable one based on their already-captured targeting answers. If no suitable survey exists, fall back to the standard quota fill redirect. At launch, this is restricted to WPP projects only; the underlying logic must be extensible to allow all projects to benefit in future.

features.title: F3.3 — Dashboard Metrics
features.overview:
Deliver the data layer for the WPP fieldwork dashboard (F1.6): an hourly per-market metrics snapshot produced inside the fieldwork-processing Step Functions workflow (EventBridge hourly start → discover → fail-closed QC gate → per-market metrics compute → S3). Each successful cycle writes a validated, aggregate-only MetricsSnapshot JSON to a dedicated snapshot bucket:

There is no HTTP API in v1 (design change 2026-08-05): the previously planned /v1/dashboard/* endpoints, ?fresh=true recompute, OpenAPI client codegen, and per-market SQS fan-out are all gone. The dashboard reads the snapshot JSON directly from S3; the embedded computedAt is the UI's "last sync" indicator. There is no per-request recompute path.

v1 is scoped to data we already capture: completes vs target, starts/in-progress/IR%, screen-out breakdown, per-QC-check counts, research-defender counts, quota-cell fill, LOI (average/median/per-section), daily completes, grade/region tallies, and per-cell drill-down data. Derived values (percentages, deltas, totals) are deliberately not stored — consumers compute them. Forecast/RAG/Fount go-live metrics are v2, blocked on WPP supplying field dates.
features.rationale: Twelve subtasks are shipped (domain scaffolding, QC method ports, metrics compute/publish, and the fail-closed gate), six more are in review (export builders, the metrics API), and eight are still to do — several of those to-dos are unresolved product decisions about export edge cases rather than started work.

acCoverage.label: Dashboard viewers read one small per-market snapshot object instead of each fanning out to Firestore
A failed compute keeps the last-known-good snapshot, badges it stale with error and attempt detail, and alarms after three missed cycles
A delayed or duplicate write can never overwrite a newer snapshot
The snapshot document validates against a strict, versioned schema containing only aggregate, non-identifying data
A QC failure fails the whole cycle closed, leaving the existing snapshot untouched
